favourite.heading: Why East Carolina can pull away
bullets: East Carolina is the better football team by 6.8 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 86% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (+6.8 pts).
Playing at East Carolina is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).
Conference strength differs and the in-season sample is still thin, worth 3.4 points to East Carolina (+3.4 pts).
Stylistically the matchup favours East Carolina by 2.1 points: ball control vs front disruption (+2.1 pts).

underdog.heading: Why App State can keep it close
bullets: The outcome range is 15.5 points wide at one sigma — p10 -7.6 to p90 +37.4 for East Carolina, so a projection of +16.4 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 6%.
60% of the model’s own input contract was empty for this game — no starter, injury or per-player talent context reached it, so the number leans on team strength more than it should.
